About Me

A little bit of everything.

I am a recent SCAD graduate with a B.F.A. in Immersive Reality and a minor in Business Management. I thrive in the in-between spaces: where chalk meets code, where a VR experience needs a pitch deck, where good design has to also make business sense.

My work spans physical art, digital interfaces, spatial experiences, and strategic presentations because the best creatives do not pick a lane, they build new roads.

AR / VR 3D Environments UI / UX Design Chalk & Illustration Business Strategy Unity & Unreal Engine Maya Adobe Creative Suite

Outside the Screen

When I am not building digital worlds I am chalking in Somerset, PA competing in Chalk the Block. Eight years in, six first place wins.
